name: Pokelawls
description: Pokelawls is one of the earliest VRChat Twitch streamers, having started playing in 2017 and co-founding [Team Five](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Team_Five) alongside fellow streamers Vince, Woops, Strippin, and Dyrus. In-game he most often goes by the character name Amish Doink, occasionally roleplaying alongside other content creators, though he dissolved Team Five's leadership in 2018 and has since only returned to VRChat occasionally, usually visiting friends like [Roflgator](https://vrchat-legends.fandom.com/wiki/Roflgator).
